profile.headline: Software Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services- North America | United Airlines
profile.summary:
Results-driven Software Engineer and Web Development professional with experience leading the design and delivery of high-performance, scalable web applications. Strong hands-on expertise in MVC-based architectures, building clean, maintainable systems, and optimizing application performance. 
Known for technical ownership, sound architectural decision-making, and translating complex business requirements into reliable, user-focused solutions.

positions.title: United Airlines | Software Engineer
positions.description:
Role Overview & Contributions

• Supported mission-critical airline systems for seat assignment, flight inventory, partner integrations, and PNR-linking
• Improved system reliability and availability through observability, incident response, and data reconciliation
• Evaluated real-world system behavior during incidents to reduce blast radius and customer impact
• Built real-time observability dashboards using Kibana, Datadog, and Dynatrace to accelerate root-cause analysis
• Led APM, log aggregation, distributed tracing, and alerting, reducing time-to-detect and time-to-impact
• Integrated Solace PubSub+ for low-latency, event-driven communication and reliable system workflows
• Developed API-driven reconciliation pipelines to identify impacted seat and flight data and prevent overbooking
• Played a key role in incident triage and deep technical investigations, speeding service recovery
• Implemented AWS CloudFormation to standardize infrastructure and reduce operational overhead
• Configured Route 53 health checks and failover to detect failures early and minimize downtime
• Centralized secrets using AWS Secrets Manager to reduce security risk and maintenance effort
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · GitHub · Kubernetes · Amazon ECS · Datadog · Kibana · Dynatrace · AppDynamics · MongoDB · Communication

positions.title: ServiceNow-Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Led business requirement analysis and data governance discussions to translate stakeholder needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions
• Designed, developed, and optimized JavaScript scripts (Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes) within the ServiceNow platform
• Managed controlled, auditable deployments to UAT using update sets
• Performed unit testing, data validation, and impact analysis to ensure platform stability and data integrity
• Acted as a data steward by enforcing data standards, resolving data quality issues, and supporting compliance and reporting needs
positions.insights: Skills: Dashboard · ServiceNow · Control Systems · Performance Dashboards · Change Management · IT Service Management

positions.title: Graduate Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
• Tutored students in Cloud Computing, covering core concepts, architectures, and real-world applications
• Tutored students in Wireless Networks, focusing on protocols, network design, and practical problem-solving

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for designing, developing, and owning a client–practitioner web application.

• Architected and implemented a service-driven web platform enabling clients to discover, compare, and engage practitioners based on services, pricing, and availability
• Designed and developed core product features including service catalog, advanced search and filtering, practitioner profiles, and client engagement workflows
• Built and optimized backend APIs and data models to support reliable interactions between clients and practitioners
• Focused on performance, scalability, and usability, ensuring a responsive user experience and stable application behavior
• Collaborated on product requirements and UX decisions, translating business needs into user-centric, production-ready features that support long-term professional relationships

positions.title: Web Developer (Upwork)
positions.description:
• Gathered and translated global client requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions
• Designed and implemented web application architecture and database schemas to support performance, reliability, and growth
• Built and maintained e-commerce integrations using Shopify Admin & Storefront APIs, Webhooks, and eBay APIs (Listings, Orders, Inventory), synchronizing 50k+ orders and product updates
• Developed and deployed custom Shopify apps, implementing OAuth authentication and event-driven workflows processing thousands of real-time events daily
• Integrated Mailchimp APIs for automated campaigns and customer segmentation, reducing manual outreach effort
• Leveraged Google APIs (OAuth 2.0, Maps, Analytics) and AWS services (S3, SES, Lambda) for authentication, storage, notifications, and backend processing
• Applied cloud-native patterns using managed services, event-driven design, and auto-scaling to improve resilience and reduce operational cost
• Optimized API workflows and backend interactions, reducing average request latency by 30–40%
• Improved system efficiency and scalability, reducing infrastructure and operational costs by 20%+
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · jQuery · PHP · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Database Design · Shopify App Development · API Development · Cross-browser Compatibility · Control Systems · Optimization Techniques · HTML5 · MySQL · Web Application Development · Hooks

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Owned server-side application logic, front-end integration, and central database maintenance, ensuring high performance and responsive APIs
• Designed and developed eCommerce websites and admin panels, supporting operational workflows and business management
• Designed and optimized database schemas to improve data integrity, query performance, and scalability
• Built dashboard interfaces using JavaScript and jQuery to visualize real-time and transactional data
• Optimized backend and frontend workflows to improve data retrieval speed and overall system efficiency
• Developed Shopify applications, integrating custom business logic and third-party services
• Built Chrome extensions to extend platform functionality and improve user productivity
• Designed and consumed RESTful APIs for secure and scalable system integrations
• Integrated Stripe for secure payment processing, handling transactions, callbacks, and error flows
• Implemented webhooks to synchronize external events and keep application data consistent and up to date
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Shopify · jQuery · PHP · cPanel · Firebase · Apache · Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) · API Development · Cross-browser Compatibility · Control Systems · Optimization Techniques · MySQL · Laravel · XAMPP · Hooks · WHM · Twilio
